data.description:
Placeholder epic for Plan B from the UI/UX quality proposal (report: docs/proposals).

Problem: 'Spacing between elements, crowded screens, visual nuances challenging to assess without visual-spatial awareness.' No agent in the current workflow ever sees rendered pixels. All visual judgment is mediated through SVG/JSON.

Deliverables:
- plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md (multimodal). Input: PNG screenshot + design manifest. Output: structured JSON scoring whitespace_balance, element_density, visual_hierarchy_legibility, alignment_grid_adherence, intent_match (each 1-5), plus findings with bounding-box coordinates.
- plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md (orchestrator wrapper): boots local app via check-local-env.sh, Playwright screenshots at routes from .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json, dispatches the agent per screenshot, aggregates.
- Integration A (inline per-task): augment plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md so sub-agents capture a screenshot and run the evaluator after implementation; iterate if any dimension <4 (cap 2 iterations).
- Integration B (post-batch): Sprint Step 12.5 after make test-visual; results feed into the review JSON consumed by design-systems-lead reviewer.
- Replace LLM-only visual_hierarchy on design-systems-lead reviewer with a fifth committee reviewer at plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md for Full track designs.

Cost controls: only run on routes touched by the diff; cache evaluations keyed by screenshot hash; haiku for inline loop, opus only post-batch.

Maps to: Paradigm 3 (AutoOptimization VLM-as-proxy-designer) in docs/proposals UI design report. Highest-leverage single addition per the proposal.

Measurable outcome: Median visual score >=4 on all five dimensions within two sprints. Baseline by running evaluator retroactively against the last 10 merged UI PRs.

Status: placeholder — requires /dso:brainstorm to expand into a full epic spec.
data.title: Plan B: VLM screenshot evaluator with inline self-correction loop
